title: AttributeError: 'AnyType' object has no attribute 'type' in try/except/else
body:
``` python
def f(): ...  # just to have something returning Any

def lookup_field(name, obj):
    try:
        pass
    except:
        attr = f()
    else:
        attr = None
```
